description.title: הגדרת מקרה ביטוח לפרק שבע
description.summary: This table defines the insured event for Chapter Seven of the 'Mekhalel' insurance policy for businesses. It details the conditions under which an employee's impairment, illness, or death is covered, focusing on work-related accidents and occupational diseases.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מגדירה את מקרה הביטוח עבור פרק שבע של פוליסת הביטוח 'מכלול' לעסקים. הפוליסה מכסה פגיעה גופנית, נפשית או פסיכולוגית, מחלת מקצוע או מוות של עובד כתוצאה מתאונה או מחלת מקצוע, בתנאי שהגורם הישיר והעיקרי לפגיעה הוא תאונה או מחלה שארעה במהלך העבודה בעסק ובמסגרת עיסוקו של המבוטח, ואינה נכללת בפוליסת 'מכלול'. במקרה של סיכון מתמשך, חבות המבטח תחושב באופן יחסי לפי תקופת החשיפה של העובד לגורם הנזק במהלך תקופת הביטוח, ביחס לתקופת החשיפה הכוללת. הפוליסה מתייחסת לפגיעה, מחלה או מוות, סיכון מתמשך, וחבות המבטח.
notable_values: Chapter Seven: Definition of insured event
Direct and main cause: Required for coverage

sketch:
1. Definition of the insured event for Chapter Seven
Physical, mental or psychological impairment or an occupational disease or death, suffered by an employee or employees who work for the insured, as a result of an accident or an occupational disease, which independently of any other factor, constitute the direct and main cause of the impairment, illness or death as aforementioned, which occur in the course of and as a result of his/ their at the insured's business and in the scope of the insured's occupation, which are not excluded by the general exclusions to the policy and/or by the exclusions listed hereunder in regard to this chapter.
Continuous risk: where the insured's liability arises from an accident or illness, which was caused by exposure of the employee to a continuous physical or tangible risk (hereinafter in this condition "the cause of the damage") in the course of and as a result of working at the business, the insurer will bear a pro-rata part of the liability, according to the ratio between the period of the employee's exposure to the cause of the damage in the course of the insurance period under this policy, and the period of the employee's exposure to the cause of the damage in general.

טבלה: הגדרת מקרה ביטוח לפרק שבע
This table defines the insured event for Chapter Seven of the 'Mekhalel' insurance policy for businesses. It details the conditions under which an employee's impairment, illness, or death is covered, focusing on work-related accidents and occupational diseases.
ממדים: Definition of insured event conditions, Details of coverage criteria

1. Definition of the insured event for Chapter Seven

Continuous risk: where the insured's liability arises from an accident or illness, which was caused by exposure of the employee to a continuous physical or tangible risk (hereinafter in this condition "the cause of the damage") in the course of and as a result of working at the business, the insurer will bear a pro-rata part of the liability, according to the ratio between the period of the employee's exposure to the cause of the damage in the course of the insurance period under this policy, and the period of the employee's exposure to the cause of the damage in general.
